stance: Housing is weak at a low level, with a tentative stabilisation signal. New home sales rose 14.2% to 701k SAAR in October, but from a September revised down to 614k from 676k. October starts rebounded 9.9% to 1,309k, while permits fell 7.4% to 1,295k, below the 1,350k warning level, so the starts bounce is likely to fade. Existing sales were 3.75M with mortgage rates near 7.4%. Residential investment stays a GDP drag. Another print above 700k would ease the concern; View is provisional.
